statusDetail: Coverage-complete report-mode audit. The requested host redirects twice and was audited at its final .live host across representative templates.

page.notes: Russian adult video catalogue. The requested .cafe origin redirects through x.sex-studentki.team to sex-studentki.live. Covered home, listing, categories, detail/comment and 404. Not covered: authenticated user/profile flows, moderation/admin surfaces, exhaustive category/model pages, and actual media playback duration, because they are separate or repetitive templates outside the anonymous primary journey.

paths.description: Homepage catalogue and primary discovery surface; covers header, category grid, long feed, preferences, responsive layout, security and performance.
All-videos listing archetype; represents repeated catalogue/card templates.
Category index archetype; verifies narrow responsive grid and overflow.
Representative video detail and comment form; covers playback, metadata, form and no-JS content.
Deliberate invalid URL to exercise HTTP/error recovery state.

findings.summary: The fixed dark theme does not follow the system colour-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The light and dark emulations produced pixel-identical screenshots, and the rendered CSS contains no prefers-color-scheme rule even though a manual theme switch exists.
findings.suggestedFix: Add color-scheme: light dark and map theme tokens through prefers-color-scheme or light-dark(), while retaining the manual override.

findings.summary: Animations continue when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe found six running CSS animations, including 3s and 6s spins, and no prefers-reduced-motion rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable non-essential spinning and transition effects inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).

findings.summary: Route and state changes are abrupt rather than using View Transitions.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection across the home, listing and detail templates found no view-transition CSS or startViewTransition usage; navigation is full-page link replacement.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document View Transitions for same-origin page changes, with a no-motion fallback.

findings.summary: The very long feed has no scroll-state-aware navigation aid.
findings.evidence: The mobile layout is 31,989px tall, while screenshots and CSS inspection show static page chrome with no progress indicator, shrinking header or scroll-state query.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll progress or scroll-state-aware header treatment, respecting reduced motion.

findings.summary: Reusable cards adapt only through page-level layout, not their own container.
findings.evidence: The mobile presentation reflows successfully, but the platform probe and CSS inspection found no @container rules on card/category components.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable grids/cards a size container and use container queries for card typography and density.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is invisible and several targets are undersized.
findings.evidence: Focusing the first link produced outline: none and no box-shadow; the probe also found visible 15px to 22px-high links/buttons.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a strong :focus-visible style and enlarge interactive hit areas to at least 24x24 CSS px, preferably 44x44 for primary touch controls.

findings.summary: The measured loading experience misses good LCP and CLS thresholds.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 5.2s and CLS 0.218 (performance 54); the trace independently measured FCP/LCP at 3.32s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP image, reserve media space, lazy-load below-fold cards and shorten the redirect/render-blocking chain.

findings.summary: Late layout movement is substantial.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured CLS 0.218. The image audit found all 94 images missing width and height attributes, leaving layout reservation dependent on CSS/load timing.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height or aspect-ratio for every thumbnail and poster and keep ad/late-content slots reserved.

findings.summary: Redirects and synchronous head resources delay useful content.
findings.evidence: The HAR recorded eight redirects, including two document redirects before the final .live origin; compressed.js is parser-inserted without async/defer and three stylesheets are render-blocking candidates.
findings.suggestedFix: Redirect directly to the canonical host, defer non-critical scripts, inline only minimal critical CSS and preload only the actual LCP resource.

findings.summary: The page ships avoidable unused JavaScript and CSS.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 103 KiB unused JavaScript and 67 KiB unused CSS; a player polyfill is loaded on the homepage where no video element exists.
findings.suggestedFix: Split player code by template, conditionally load dependencies, and remove unused CSS from the homepage bundle.

findings.summary: Prominent controls and images lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found unnamed icon links, an unnamed theme button and images without alt; the image audit counted 12 missing alt attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: Add concise accessible names to icon-only links/buttons and meaningful or empty alt text to every image as appropriate.

findings.summary: Page landmarks, heading hierarchy and focus visibility are incomplete.
findings.evidence: The homepage has no h1 and no main/nav/header/footer landmarks; Lighthouse failed the main-landmark audit and the active focus probe showed no visible outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Use semantic header/nav/main/footer landmarks, one descriptive h1 per template, and a consistent :focus-visible treatment.

findings.summary: Zoom, targets and video alternatives do not meet an inclusive baseline.
findings.evidence: The viewport caps zoom at maximum-scale=2, visible controls as small as 15px high were measured, and the detail video exposes no caption tracks.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the zoom cap, enlarge targets, and provide captions/transcripts for video content.

findings.summary: The document and image assets are not soundly declared.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports no HTML doctype (quirks mode), while the image audit found 94/94 images without intrinsic dimensions and 93 without srcset.
findings.suggestedFix: Add <!doctype html>, intrinsic image dimensions and responsive srcset/sizes markup.

findings.summary: Sitemap/indexing signals are incomplete across the redirecting host.
findings.evidence: The requested .cafe URL redirects twice to .live; robots.txt names .live but does not declare a sitemap, and /sitemap.xml returns 200 with an empty body.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one direct canonical redirect and publish a populated sitemap referenced from robots.txt.

findings.summary: Rich video entities lack structured data.
findings.evidence: The detail template has five Open Graph tags but zero JSON-LD blocks despite representing a video; the homepage has neither Open Graph nor JSON-LD.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate VideoObject JSON-LD to detail pages and complete Open Graph/Twitter metadata on shareable templates.

findings.summary: Core transport security headers are absent.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive confirmed HTTPS but found no CSP, HSTS or X-Content-Type-Options header.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a restrictive CSP, long-lived HSTS after deployment validation, and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.

findings.summary: Tracking and advertising requests start without an observed consent or minimisation step.
findings.evidence: The HAR recorded Yandex requests plus octo/timdovs/grandtorank origins; Lighthouse observed 16 third-party cookies and the tracker probe counted 12 third-party origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate non-essential analytics/ads behind meaningful consent, minimise fields and retention, and self-host or remove unnecessary dependencies.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are missing.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found no clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy, in addition to no CSP/HSTS.
findings.suggestedFix: Add CSP frame-ancestors (or X-Frame-Options where needed), strict Referrer-Policy and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Russian pages do not declare their language.
findings.evidence: The rendered html element has no lang value on home, listing, detail or 404 templates; Lighthouse failed html-has-lang.
findings.suggestedFix: Set lang="ru" on every template and use dir/logical CSS properties so future locale variants remain robust.

findings.summary: The comment form does not expose robust validation or error semantics.
findings.evidence: The detail form has unlabeled name/message controls, no required state, no aria-invalid/error association and submits with GET to the current URL.
findings.suggestedFix: Use explicit labels, POST submission, after-interaction validation, accessible error announcements and a recoverable success/error state.

findings.summary: Comment identity input lacks autofill assistance.
findings.evidence: The name field has an empty autocomplete attribute and relies on placeholder text instead of a label.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a persistent label and an appropriate autocomplete token such as name.

findings.summary: The image catalogue is not responsively delivered.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 93/94 images without srcset, 94 without dimensions, two oversized assets and one legacy PNG; Lighthouse also found low-resolution delivery.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate responsive WebP/AVIF variants with srcset/sizes, dimensions and correctly sized logo assets.

findings.summary: The homepage eagerly fetches nearly the entire long feed.
findings.evidence: The HAR recorded 121 requests including 99 images and 1.68 MB transferred; 88 below-fold images lacked loading=lazy.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-load below-fold thumbnails, paginate or virtualise the 32k-pixel feed, and defer background analytics/ad work.

findings.summary: Third-party overhead is disproportionate to first-view value.
findings.evidence: The HAR attributes about 208 KB to non-site origins including Yandex and ad-tech, with multiple cookie-sync redirects; the final page also loads five fonts.
findings.suggestedFix: Set an explicit third-party budget, remove cookie-sync chains, subset/self-host fonts and defer optional media/trackers.
